# Erdos.p1 — Erdős problem 1

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1.lean`, theorem `erdos_1`, AMS 5 11).

If $A\subseteq\{1, ..., N\}$ with $|A| = n$ is such that the subset sums $\sum_{a\in S}a$ are
distinct for all $S\subseteq A$ then
$$
  N \gg 2 ^ n.
$$

## Statement
∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ (N : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) (_ : IsSumDistinctSet A N),
    N ≠ 0 → C * 2 ^ A.card < N

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
